textContent:
* A is nothing but a common man/ worrier (Like Karna) but he turns out to be the true heir to the Throne! (Flexible theory can be replaced by any other story)
* H is the one who shows the way to victory to A by constantly giving lessons from Mahabharat. Just like Krishna to Arjuna!
• In this universe H will betray A and becomes the most powerfull H of all the universes! The dominator H. 
• H regrets his decisions as soon as his betrayal and was punished/ cursed for eternal life like Ashwathama. 
• It is a very fast moving episode where H is narrating his back story in the initial days that how he was able to outsmart all the dynasties and finally helped his supported king to win over all and created the Akhand Bharat but in the end he became too self centric when the King did not appreciate his efforts. So he decided to out-throw him and his lineage by killing both King and the pregnant queen. 
• In the end B curses him with eternal lowly life like Ashwathama! 
• He suffers a lot until he realises the truth of the universe and gets power from the other universes. He was able to communicate with other universes through his own character in each universe. 
• Finally he was seen observing the First universe through H and learns to control the powers from each universe and take all the experience. 
• He is the Untimate H!!!!
title: GOT + Mahabharat world
textContentHtml:
* A is nothing but a common man/ worrier (Like Karna) but he turns out to be the true heir to the Throne! (Flexible theory can be replaced by any other story)

* H is the one who shows the way to victory to A by constantly giving lessons from Mahabharat. Just like Krishna to Arjuna!

• In this universe H will betray A and becomes the most powerfull H of all the universes! The dominator H. 

• H regrets his decisions as soon as his betrayal and was punished/ cursed for eternal life like Ashwathama. 

• It is a very fast moving episode where H is narrating his back story in the initial days that how he was able to outsmart all the dynasties and finally helped his supported king to win over all and created the Akhand Bharat but in the end he became too self centric when the King did not appreciate his efforts. So he decided to out-throw him and his lineage by killing both King and the pregnant queen. 

• In the end B curses him with eternal lowly life like Ashwathama! 

• He suffers a lot until he realises the truth of the universe and gets power from the other universes. He was able to communicate with other universes through his own character in each universe. 

• Finally he was seen observing the First universe through H and learns to control the powers from each universe and take all the experience. 

• He is the Untimate H!!!!
